crossRefs.note: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified…
The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do…
The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about…
If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in…
Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself…
Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
“Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs…
Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
translations.bsb: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
translations.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
translations.asv: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father hath given me to accomplish, the very works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
